messages:
Nora (partnerships): Heads-up: planning a joint rehearsal for the marketplace publish. Need to stitch HW partner badge flow, SI activation path, and press/marketing timing. Slot proposal: Thu 09:30 PT. Who's in?
Keita (cloud-ops): I can take infra cutover checklist and staging routing. Need to confirm region failover for eu-west.
Sam (marketing): I'll own the landing copy + hero variations. Can we get partner-approved logo files and two short quotes? Prefer svg + png at 2x.
Priya (legal): Quick note: partner badge text needs the approved attribution line. I posted the legal snippet here: https://drive.redwood/legal/partner-terms.md. Partners must sign the logo usage addendum before publish.
Hugo (eng): Integration status: tenant provisioning and OAuth flow done. Still wiring the billing meter events to the marketplace ingest. Small config yaml below for QA use:
```
# staging-billing.yaml
billing_namespace: marketplace_beta
emit_meter_events: true
event_types: [tokens, embeddings]
```
Nora (partnerships): @Sam @Priya can you coordinate to get the signed addendum + quote by Wed EOD? Need to freeze hero assets Wed night to give eng time.
Sam (marketing): Will ping partner PMs now. Also building a lightweight hero that supports a small quote and a CTA toggle: "Launch in Hosted" / "Contact Sales".
Priya (legal): I'll follow up with Nimbus legal and EdgeWorks counsel. If we don't have signatures by Wed EOD, we should plan an alternate hero that omits partner quote.
Keita (cloud-ops): Staging endpoints will be: https://staging.marketplace.redwood/preview/nimbus and https://staging.marketplace.redwood/preview/edgeworks. Will add ephemeral DNS entries for rehearsal.
Hugo (eng): Can we have a smoke test script to validate tenant isolation + meter events? I can share a tiny script for the rehearsal.
Nora (partnerships): Yes please. @Hugo share script link in thread. Also need an SI handoff doc: sequence for onboarding an SI (steps, creds, validation).
Hugo (eng): Shared script: https://git.redwood/repo/marketplace/tests/rehearsal-smoke.sh. It runs provision -> run inference -> check meter event.
Sam (marketing): Press timing: propose staggered announce: marketplace page live at 09:00 PT then coordinated partner quotes at 09:30 PT. PR to embargo until 08:45 PT. Thoughts?
Priya (legal): Sounds ok but confirm partners agree to the 09:30 quote release. If any partner requests earlier/later slip we need to update press embargo.
Keita (cloud-ops): During rehearsal avoid heavy generation runs on the staging tenants between 09:00-09:40 to keep quotas stable.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for Thu 07:45 PT -> 08:15 PT. (reaction :rocket:)
Nora (partnerships): Draft runbook for the rehearsal:
- 09:30 - 09:35 quick sync + roles (Nora)
- 09:35 - 09:50 SI onboarding demo (Hugo/Keita)
- 09:50 - 10:05 Provision + smoke test (Hugo)
- 10:05 - 10:20 Hero + landing toggle check (Sam)
- 10:20 - 10:30 Press embargo simulated release & fallback (Priya/Sam)
Can everyone confirm availability for Thu 09:30 PT?
Hugo (eng): Confirmed. I'll run the smoke script and monitor meter events.
Keita (cloud-ops): Confirmed. I'll stand by for DNS and routing changes.
Sam (marketing): Confirmed. I'll bring alternate hero variant if legal doesn't clear quote.
Priya (legal): Confirmed. I'll simulate an embargo leak scenario and the takedown step.
Nora (partnerships): Outstanding action items from thread:
- partner logo files + signed addendum -> owner: Sam/Priya / due Wed EOD
- hero freeze -> owner: Sam / due Wed 11:59pm PT
- 2 staging preview tenants + ephemeral DNS -> owner: Keita / due Wed AM
- smoke test script + runbook -> owner: Hugo / due Wed EOD
- press embargo plan -> owner: Sam / due Thu 07:00 PT
If anything blocks please flag asap. I'll follow up with a calendar invite and slack reminder. :sparkles:
